data.title: Sobha 330 Riverside Crescent
data.about:
Indulge in the captivating waterfront setting of 330 Riverside Crescent, an architectural masterpiece created by Sobha Realty that overlooks Dubai’s shimmering waterways and glimmering lights. This crescent-shaped tower reflects the vibrant colors of its surroundings, creating a magical atmosphere for residents to enjoy. 

Live a life of luxury in our beautifully appointed one- or two-bedroom apartments with stunning ocean views. Every aspect of 330 Riverside Crescent has been meticulously crafted to offer the utmost opulence. Immerse yourself in the tranquil ambiance and breathtaking views of the ocean from the open terrace gardens. Located in Sobha Hartland 2, only 15 minutes away from Downtown Dubai, this location provides easy access to the city’s major thoroughfares, as well as a plethora of shops and restaurants. Embrace the inviting and enchanting charm of 330 Riverside Crescent, your new home.

location_tile.title: Sobha 330 Riverside is situated in one of Dubai’s most prestigious neighborhoods, Sobha Hartland 2
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Hartland 2 community is located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and can be reached by three major roads: Al Ain Road, Ras Al Khor Road/Al Khail Road, and Manama Street/Meydan Road. A proposed metro station and line are also on the way!

  • 05 Mins from Ral Al Khor Sanctuary
  • 10 Mins from Meydan Racecourse
  • 10 Mins from 2 International Schools
  • 12 Mins from Business Bay
  • 12 Mins from Dubai International Airport
  • 15 Mins from The Dubai Mall
